summary: Two-part round aluminum shaft adapter for a 5 mm motor shaft. The main piece is a stepped hub with a larger flange and a smaller-diameter nose. A separate flat round washer clamps a wheel against the hub with three screws. The hub has a central bore, three axial holes around the bore, and two radial holes in the flange. The values below describe the hub only. The washer is a separate thin disc of roughly 22 mm diameter and 3 mm thickness.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat end face of the smaller-diameter hub nose. The separate washer clamps a wheel against this face using the three axial holes.
Flat end face of the larger flange, which sits toward the motor. The 5 mm bore opens through it onto the motor shaft.

notes: No drawing or printed dimensions are visible, and the supplied dimensions_mm values are null except the 5 mm shaft diameter, so the other sizes are estimates. The 25 mm flange diameter and 15 mm hub length are estimates scaled from the photos and the stated 608-bearing compatibility. The 608 bearing outer diameter is 22 mm, which suggests the nose and washer are about that size. The 3 mm axial hole diameter is assumed from the stated M3 clamping screws, and the 4 mm radial hole diameter from the stated M4 set screws. The 7.5 mm bolt-circle radius and the z-positions are visual estimates. The photos show the three axial holes spaced evenly around the bore and two radial holes in the flange. I assumed the radial holes are 90° apart, which is not confirmed. The washer has a central opening and three holes matching the hub, but their sizes are not stated.
